api.reason: A-xstyle: use the host (class, style), ::part(base) or the documented attributes.
A test-selector attribute; any attribute on the host passes through.

api.notes: Only `inherit`; unset uses the Tecton code text size.

api.reason: The element itself is the handle; the `<code>` is reachable as part "base".

differences.text: The muted surface is --color-background-muted (as upstream) with the Tecton code type: --font-family-code (IBM Plex Mono), --text-code-size (mediumData) and the numeric font-size-adjust --font-size-adjust-code so inline code matches the x-height of Figtree text (styling.md §13).

The host is an inline box and the real <code> is inside the shadow root (part "base"), so the browser exposes the code role. The text is slotted, so it wraps with the paragraph; overflow-wrap is anywhere instead of upstream's break-word plus word-break.
Forced colours give the code a ButtonBorder edge (backgrounds are dropped there) and CanvasText text.

core.code.notes: Guides: [mwg:visually-stable-mixed-fonts] numeric font-size-adjust for the mono family, unsupported browsers keep natural size and the metric-matched fallback faces; [mwg:styling-web-components] part=base; [mwg:css] logical properties, tokens.
